name: Firefly Catch
description: A dusk meadow, a glass jar and slow glowing fireflies. Slide the jar to catch them for a calm round of 60, 90 or 180 seconds, or with no clock. Missed ones just fly away.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Fireflies drift slowly down a dusk meadow. Slide a glass jar along the bottom to catch them.
help.goal: Catch as many fireflies as you like in a calm round of 60, 90 or 180 seconds, or with no clock at all. There are no lives and no game over; missed fireflies just fly away.
howToPlay: Move the jar left and right under a drifting firefly.
A firefly that drifts into the jar mouth is caught.
When the round time is up the round ends and shows how many you caught. Pausing stops the clock. Untimed rounds never end by themselves.
Press Play again for a new round. Length switches between 60, 90 and 180 seconds and untimed, and starts a new round. Your best is remembered for each timed length; untimed rounds keep no best.

controls.action: Start or resume after the Ready prompt
Reach the on-screen Left, Right, New round and Length buttons

tips: Sit under a firefly early and let it drift into the jar.
Reduced motion makes fireflies slower and move in straight lines.
You can stop at any time. Your round is saved and waits for you.
